history.summary: A freehold 2BR (840 sqft) at Terra Hill, Pasir Panjang (D05), a recently-TOP'd Hoi Hup/Sunway project on the West Coast corridor, listed at $2,478 psf — below the project's ~$2,650-2,690 transacting average. Freehold RCR with GSW/One-North tailwinds and a below-median entry make a reasonable case; the new-launch pricing bias and ~$2.08M 2BR quantum temper it.
history.rating_rationale: Web research confirms Terra Hill is a freehold luxury project (Hoi Hup/Sunway, Yew Siang Road) with 12-month transactions averaging ~$2,650 psf (range $2,234-$2,857) and a $2,795k median. This 2BR at $2,478 psf is below that average and ~8% under the $2,690 URA median — a genuine entry discount on a freehold asset, with an efficient 840 sqft 2BR layout (not oversized) and a liquid ~$2.08M quantum. D05 West Coast/Pasir Panjang is a real RCR growth corridor: Greater Southern Waterfront transformation, One-North/NUS proximity, and Pasir Panjang/Kent Ridge connectivity. Freehold removes lease risk. Two checks keep this a Buy not Strong Buy: has_new_launch_bias is true (the $2,690 median is fresh developer/early-resale pricing, not a seasoned series, despite 192 txns), and the absolute psf is high so forward appreciation must come from the GSW/One-North story rather than cheapness. On balance a below-market freehold RCR entry with strong structural tailwinds — Buy.
red_flags: New-launch pricing bias — the $2,690 median reflects fresh developer/early-resale pricing, no seasoned resale track record
High absolute psf (~$2,478) — limited cheapness cushion; upside depends on the GSW/One-North story
790m MRT walk — accessible but not doorstep
Missing built_year in dossier (recently TOP'd new project)
catalysts: Greater Southern Waterfront transformation (D4/D5) — multi-decade RCR catalyst
One-North tech hub / NUS / West Coast corridor demand
Freehold tenure in a growth RCR district; below-median entry price
